name: Desperate Refugee
desc: Someone from the fleet who has run out of options, and knows it.

intro: A thin figure in a fleet-issue blanket steps into your way, holding a kitchen knife in both hands. They tell you they're sorry before you've said anything.
Someone pushes out of the crowd and grabs at what you're carrying. When you turn, you see a knife, and a face that hasn't eaten in days.
hit: The knife catches your arm, and they look more frightened by it than you are.
They swing with their eyes shut, and it still hurts you.
They grab your coat and hang on with surprising strength, and the knife comes around at you again.
miss: The knife goes wide of you, and the swing nearly takes them off their feet.
You step aside, and they stumble past you, gasping with the effort.
They lunge at you, stop, and look at the knife as if someone else had put it there.
crit: They throw their whole weight at you, everything they have left, and the knife finds you before either of you understands what's happened.
defeated: They drop the knife and sit down on the deck, and you can see how thin their wrists are.
They put both hands up, and ask you very quietly whether the children on their ship will still get fed.
joins: {Enemy} pushes out of the crowd behind you, with the same hollow look, no longer caring who sees.
stunned: {Enemy} stares at you and shakes, and can't make themselves come any closer.
persuade_worked: You ask about the children on their ship. They start to answer, and then they're crying, and the knife's on the deck between you.
You say you're not going to report this. They look at the knife as if someone else had put it there, and they let it fall.
pay_worked: You hold out the credits, and they take them in both hands. They say they're sorry again, and they keep saying it as they back into the crowd.
threaten_worked: You don't have to say much. They were never going to do it, and now they know you know. They drop the knife, and they run.
